long_biography.plain_text:
Georgios M. Rokas entered renewable energy through the family enterprise co-founded by his father, Meletios. He worked across finance and commercial operations before becoming an executive vice chairman responsible for wind-farm analysis, construction and multidisciplinary teams. That experience gave him an unusually deep technical and commercial grounding in Greece's emerging private renewables market.

After the family's earlier company was sold, Rokas established R Energy1 as a separate business. As founder, chairman and chief executive, he has led the acquisition, development and operation of photovoltaic parks, wind farms and energy-storage projects. He also rebuilt majority ownership through his holding company after buying back an outside investor's stake. His career therefore combines a privileged family platform with the creation and continuing control of a new renewable-power group.
